title: Wings Hoodie · Black
garment: 350 g washed (snow-wash) cotton pullover hoodie, unisex, colour washed black. Supplier: Suning Sufang Yazhi Clothing Co., Ltd.
sizeNote: Sizes are for a size L. Use the same transfer size on every garment size. On S, move the back print up to 8 cm below the hood seam.

placements.name: Back
placements.what: Engraved angel wings with a halo, FINAL HEAVEN underneath, all white
placements.where: Centre it left to right. Measure from the seam where the hood joins the back, at the centre: the top edge of the print sits 8 cm below that seam.

placements.name: Front
placements.where: Top middle of the chest. Centre it left to right. The top edge sits 6 cm below the point where the hood crosses over at the neck.

placements.name: Sleeves
placements.what: "Final Heaven" on one line, slim script
placements.thread: Bright white polyester, 40 wt. One colour, no outline.
placements.where: On both sleeves, on the outer forearm, centred on the sleeve's top fold, just above the cuff band: the bottom edge sits 1.5 cm above the seam where the cuff rib starts. It reads upright when the arms hang down. Do not mirror it.
